title: Create Expandable Routine Card
description: Build RoutineCardView.kt for parent habits with expand/collapse chevron icon, animation state management, and nested child habit display. When collapsed, displays completion count (e.g., '3') with total child count in parentheses (e.g., 'AM Vitamins (5)') instead of checkmarks. Maintains horizontal scrollable timeline for routine-level aggregated progress.
